t: You're looking at a bronze equestrian statue of Field Marshal Frederick Roberts, Earl Roberts, at Horse Guards Parade. The sculptor was Harry Bates, a leading figure in the movement known as New Sculpture. Roberts was born in India and won the Victoria Cross during the Indian Rebellion. He went on to fight in Abyssinia and in the Second Anglo-Afghan War, which made him famous, and he later served as Commander-in-Chief, India, and led British forces for a year in the Second Boer War. The statue was erected to commemorate him in connection with his service in the First World War.
